fact: From 2 November 2026 interoperable e-money transfers between individuals in the UEMOA must go through the BCEAO's PI-SPI platform, to which banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions had a deadline (moved to 30 September 2026) to connect.
title: Transferts monétaires interopérables : la BCEAO rend PI-SPI obligatoire pour les particuliers dès novembre 2026
